text.text: Aquarium air pump is clogged by some moss. Unclog the air pump and clean the aquarium.
You're hungry. There's a automatic fish food dispenser. Go and eat/collect the fish food and fill your hunger bar.
You're out of food now and your owner still hasn't come back. Look for a way to get some food. You must think outside of box (aquarium).
Now that you've the food, it's time to go back to your aquarium, but be careful. If you fall on the floor, you must find a way to get back insde the aquarium.
Your owner is back and he brought a new female fish with him. You must impress her if you want to live with her.
